commit 12ebeb972e2bea88bec939a9ca9b436db884de13
Author: Ivan Tugay <listepo@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Oct 14 23:25:53 2026 +0300

    feat: T660.3 nested worktrees do not leak into walks, gc or clean (#1072)
    
    A linked worktree nested in its project (under .rtok/worktrees) is another checkout: search, tree, the graph walk and the watcher skip it, gc and clean take the deepest worktree as current, origin names the rtok pool, and a new worktree's symbol index copies no rows under .rtok/. Submodules and nested clones stay walked.
